PROVEN_LIVE_FACTS_2026-09-23:
- Ollama API listener PID 1085 on TCP 11434.
- GET / => 200 "Ollama is running".
- GET /api/version => {"version":"0.34.3"}.
- qwen3:8b is loaded; llama-server PID 4348 on 127.0.0.1:50448.
- SUPRA bridge PID 1026 listens 127.0.0.1:18765 with model ollama/qwen3-8b.
- Codex PID 8433 has two ESTABLISHED sockets to 127.0.0.1:11434.
- Direct POST /api/generate for qwen3:8b timed out after 30s with 0 bytes.
- Exact Codex failure is:
  unexpected status 502 Bad Gateway:
  http2: Transport: cannot retry err [stream error: stream ID 1; PROTOCOL_ERROR; received from peer] after Request.Body was written; define Request.GetBody to avoid this error
  url: http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/codex/v1/responses
- Upstream Ollama currently has open issue #18375 for the same 502 path on macOS.
- Upstream issue #18419 proves /api/codex/v1/responses mishandles previous_response_id tool follow-up; PR #18439 is only a partial rejection fix, not a proven full repair.
- Therefore do NOT assume SUPRA bridge is root cause and do NOT update Ollama to a prerelease.

CURRENT_CODEX_TASK_TO_RESUME:
Close targeted evidence gaps B/C:
B = prove session input count + customize part count + distinct customize call IDs + first/second customize status and identify duplicate generator.
C = historical permission/doom_loop/permission.asked/permission.replied proof around exact failing timestamps.
If no historical permission record exists, C=NOT_PROVEN, never FALSE.
Do not widen investigation.

DO NOW:
1) FIRST inspect, read-only and secret-safe:
   - ~/.codex/config.toml
   - ~/.codex/ollama-launch-codex-routing.json
   - any existing Codex provider/base_url config backups already present
   - process command line/environment metadata that can be read without exposing tokens/secrets
   - existing OpenCode sessions on 127.0.0.1:4096
   Determine exactly why gpt-5.6-sol Codex traffic is going through 127.0.0.1:11434/api/codex/v1/responses.
2) Do NOT call prompt_async/model to simulate shell execution.
   Use the EXISTING OpenCode direct shell route:
   POST /session/{id}/shell
   body {agent, model?, command}
   or its existing local client/helper if already present.
3) Close B and C from persisted session/events/logs only. Use bounded exact searches around the failure timestamps. No global rescan.
4) If and ONLY IF local proof shows Codex gpt-5.6-sol is being proxied through Ollama because of an existing reversible provider/base_url override, and an already-existing prior direct Codex/OpenAI configuration is available locally:
   - preserve a timestamped backup;
   - restore ONLY the proven prior direct provider/base_url configuration;
   - do not touch model choice, auth secrets, SUPRA bridge, OpenCode, Ollama model files, or application architecture;
   - verify with one bounded Codex transport check that no request for gpt-5.6-sol hits 127.0.0.1:11434/api/codex/v1/responses.
5) If no proven prior direct configuration exists, DO NOT invent one and DO NOT mutate Codex config. Still close B/C using direct shell/persisted evidence.
6) Do not restart or kill SUPRA, bridge 18765, OpenCode 4096, Ollama, qwen runner, or Codex unless an existing reversible recovery procedure explicitly requires it and the exact blocker is proven.
7) Do not install/update Ollama, Codex, OpenCode, macOS, or any prerelease.
8) Preserve the current Codex task/session. Do not create a replacement investigation front.
9) Publish the result through the existing proof/OUTBOX mechanism if available.
